title: EE60012: Optimal Control
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Static optimization, Linear programming, Simplex methods. Dynamic
optimization.Calculus of variations, Eulers equation, application to control
problems. Pontryagins maximum principle, control with constrains, time optimal
control. Optimal tracking control problem, Gain scheduling, Model reference and
Self-tuning control problem. Discrete optimal control, Bellmans dynamic
programming method. Continuous Kalman Filter, Square root Kalman filter. Nonlinear system optimization, Gradient optimization techniques, steepest ascent
and decent in parameter plane, Rosenbrocks conjugate gradient method,
DavidâFletcher-Power method, etc. Evolutionary methods, Genetic algorithms
